Samwell Staxford, named in-game as Dead Zealot of the Absolute, was an Absolutist zealot on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail during Act One. After he accidentally stumbled upon hostile githyanki youth, he raised a group of undead  Death Shepherds and  Ghouls to assist him but ultimately perished in the ensuing fight.

Involvement

Act One

Following the capture of  Duke Ravengard from Waukeen's Rest by goblins loyal to the Absolute, Samwell Staxford was amongst those tasked to bring the duke to the Absolute by  General Ketheric Thorm. He and his party presumably escorted the captive duke through the Rosymorn Monastery Trail to Moonrise Towers, before accidentally encountering a group of githyanki youth training outside Rosymorn Monastery.

Samwell Staxford's party left him and another zealot[1] behind to fight the githyanki,[2] prompting him to summon the undead to help but the two ultimately perished in their attempt to escape. His corpse is surrounded by two  Death Shepherds, a  Ghast, and several  Ghouls.

    • Dead Zealot of the Absolute
      Following... orders... of... General... Thorm...

          Find... Duke... Ravengard... Bring... him... to... the... Absolute...

        • Dead Zealot of the Absolute

      Githyanki... youths...
      • Why did the githyanki attack you?

          Stumbled... upon... them... interrupted... training... Didn't... realise... they... were... here...
  • Where did these undead come from?
    • Dead Zealot of the Absolute
      I... summoned... them... To... fight... against... githyanki... attack... To... buy... time... for... the others... To... escape... with... Ravengard...
      • Why did the githyanki attack you?
        • Dead Zealot of the Absolute
          Stumbled... upon... them... interrupted... training... Didn't... realise... they... were... here...
      • What were you doing with Ravengard?
        • Dead Zealot of the Absolute
          General... Thorm's... orders... To... bring... him... to... the... Absolute...
          • Who is General Thorm?
            • Dead Zealot of the Absolute
              Leader... of... True... Souls... Chosen... of... the... Absolute...
          • What does the Absolute want with Duke Ravengard?
            • Narrator
              *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
      • Where is the Duke Ravengard now?
        • Narrator
          *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*

Notes

  • Samwell Staxford's portrait and physical appearance are completely identical to that of  Zealot Malik.
  • It is unclear how Samwell Staxford raised undead to assist in the fight, as Zealots of the Absolute do not have access to  Animate Dead or any similar spells.
